title: Garner profile
description: Which releases Garner accepts for a show and how it ranks them. https://github.com/trucke/garner/blob/main/docs/profiles.md describes the format.

name.description: The profile's name, unique within one Garner.

description.description: One line that lists and the preview show.

audio.description: Accepted audio languages, best first. original is the show's original language.

priority.description: Which list counts more when Garner ranks the preferences.

dual_audio.description: Whether a release that also has the show's original audio ranks first.

unnamed_audio.description: A release marked dual or multi that names no languages: reject it, or take it as a last resort and check it after download.

upgrades.description: Replace a file below the first preference when a release in a better preference appears.
